# Setup is check-only

There is no `apply` action: everything this check reports is a system setting the plugin must not write. Raising or disabling the screensaver is your decision.
**`apply` isn't an action here.** The only action is `check`, which reports and hands the change to you.

| Item | Result |
|---|---|
| apply | Not available: setup is read-only |
| Screensaver | Your call to raise or disable |
Nothing apply could write: the screensaver is a system setting, so I'll leave it to you.
